visualCharacteristics.purpose: Side-by-side promo offers, each with image, heading, text, a Book now button and a secondary link

contentPattern.structure: One row; one cell per offer, each holding image, heading, text, primary button link and optional secondary link (the last standalone link is styled as secondary)

reuseGuidance: Use for two or three distinct promotional offers shown together. For repeated look-alike items use cards.
